title: Schools Recommendation Scheme offers released
audience: Eligible 2026 Year 12 UAC applicants who applied for SRS
location: Online via UAC and applicant email
summary: UAC releases conditional and unconditional Schools Recommendation Scheme offers to domestic applicants at 10 am. Check your email or UAC application; a conditional offer may include an ATAR, prerequisite or other condition to meet.

title: TAFE NSW Virtual Open Week
summary: Join TAFE NSW online from 17–19 November to explore courses, meet teachers, compare career pathways and ask questions about study. Registration is through the TAFE NSW event page.

title: UAC application deadline for December Round 1
audience: Non-school applicants seeking December Round 1 consideration, and SRS applicants finalising course preferences
summary: Non-school applicants must submit and pay for a UAC undergraduate application by 11:59 pm for December Round 1 consideration. SRS applicants must also lock in course preferences by 11:59 pm; SRS applications closed on 11 September.

title: Academy of Interactive Entertainment Open Day
audience: Students and families exploring game development, 3D animation, film and visual effects training
summary: Meet AIE teachers, staff and students at its Sydney, Melbourne, Canberra or Adelaide campus from 10 am–3 pm. Sessions cover courses, career pathways, industry links, software and skills, entry requirements and how to apply. Register with AIE.

title: UAC application deadline for the December Round 2 main offer round
audience: Year 12 and non-school applicants applying through UAC for semester 1, 2027
summary: Submit and pay for your undergraduate application by 11:59 pm to be considered in the December Round 2 main offer round on 23 December. Course availability and participating institutions vary; check your preferences and supporting-document deadlines in UAC.

title: Lock in preferences for the main UAC offer round
audience: Applicants seeking consideration in the 23 December main offer round
summary: Review and lock in your UAC course preferences by 11:59 pm for the December Round 2 main offer round on 23 December. UAC preferences are temporarily locked between the deadline and offer release.

title: Main UAC offer round for semester 1, 2027
audience: Applicants with an assessable qualification applying for participating semester 1, 2027 courses
location: Online via UAC and applicant email
summary: UAC releases December Round 2 offers at 7:30 am. This is the main offer round and the first ATAR-based round for 2026 Year 12 applicants. Not every institution or course makes offers in this round; check the provider’s schedule and your UAC account.

title: National Careers Week
summary: National Careers Week runs 10–16 May 2027 and promotes career exploration across schools, training and workplaces. Organisers invite students, educators and employers to join activities or register an event; check the official calendar for local sessions as they are published.

title: AIE Online Campus Day
audience: Students interested in studying game development, animation, film or visual effects online
summary: Join AIE’s online campus day livestream, starting at 11 am, to learn about its online study options. Check the event page for registration and session details.

title: NSW HSC results released
summary: NESA releases 2026 HSC results from 6 am. Students can view results through Students Online; check NESA for access instructions and result support.

title: 2026 NSW ATARs released
audience: NSW HSC students eligible for an ATAR
summary: UAC makes NSW ATARs available from 9 am. An ATAR is a rank, not a mark; compare course requirements using the current UAC and university information.

title: Conditional SRS offers converted after ATAR release
audience: Domestic applicants holding a conditional SRS offer
location: Online through UAC and applicant email
summary: UAC updates eligible domestic students’ conditional SRS offers after the main offer round. Conversion depends on meeting the institution’s stated conditions; check your offer and UAC account.
